title: Household wealth is abandoned, but hard to share in the goal of asceticism. One brings harm to oneself and brings distraction, Like a funeral torch…
content:
Household wealth is abandoned, but hard to share in the goal of asceticism.
One brings harm to oneself and brings distraction,
Like a funeral torch that goes to destruction.

Many who wear the yellow robe,
Of evil nature, unrestrained,
By their evil deeds, certainly go to hell.

Better to swallow a red-hot iron ball,
Blazing like a fire,
Than for an immoral, unrestrained person
To eat the country's almsfood.

title: Possessing forty qualities, as such is placed in heaven. What forty? He himself abstains from killing living beings, does not encourage others to kill, does…
content: Possessing forty qualities, as such is placed in heaven. What forty? He himself abstains from killing living beings, does not encourage others to kill, does not consent to killing, and does not praise killing; he himself abstains from taking what is not given, does not encourage others to take what is not given, does not consent to taking what is not given, and does not praise taking what is not given; he himself abstains from sexual misconduct, does not encourage others to engage in sexual misconduct, does not consent to sexual misconduct, and does not praise sexual misconduct; he himself does not speak falsely, does not encourage others to speak falsely, does not consent to false speech, and does not praise false speech; he himself abstains from divisive speech, does not encourage others to speak divisively, does not consent to divisive speech, and does not praise divisive speech; he himself does not speak harshly, does not encourage others to speak harshly, does not consent to harsh speech, and does not praise harsh speech; he himself abstains from idle chatter, does not encourage others to speak idly, does not consent to idle chatter, and does not praise idle chatter; he himself is not covetous, does not encourage others to be covetous, does not consent to covetousness, and does not praise covetousness; he himself has no ill-will, does not encourage others to have ill-will, does not consent to ill-will, and does not praise ill-will; he himself has right view, encourages others to have right view, consents to right view, and praises right view. Possessing these forty qualities, bhikkhus, as such is placed in heaven.

title: There are these four occasions, bhikkhus, that, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints. What four? Hearing the…
content: There are these four occasions, bhikkhus, that, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints. What four? Hearing the Dhamma at the right time, discussing the Dhamma at the right time, calming at the right time, contemplating at the right time. These four occasions, bhikkhus, if well developed and well conducted, lead progressively to the destruction of the taints.

title: This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of…
content: This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. This is impossible. It is possible, bhikkhus, that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a plane of misery, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell. This is possible. This is impossible, bhikkhus, it cannot happen: that a person who has done evil verbal actions... evil mental actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. This is impossible. It is possible, bhikkhus, that a person who has done evil bodily actions, by reason thereof, after death, with the breakup of the body, could be reborn in a plane of misery, a bad destination, a lower realm, hell. This is possible.

title: A learner training, practicing the straight path, In the destruction of evil states is the first knowledge, Next is final knowledge — that final knowledge…
content:
A learner training, practicing the straight path,
In the destruction of evil states is the first knowledge,
Next is final knowledge — that final knowledge is unsurpassed.

After that final knowledge, liberation itself,
Liberation knowledge unsurpassed
In the destruction of evil states, the wise.
Here the various fetters are destroyed.

Not the lazy, the fool who knows nothing,
Can attain this unsurpassed Nibbāna,
The complete liberation from all bonds.

title: Venerable Sir, if it is indeed difficult for me, following different views, accepting different things, pursuing different goals, following different aims, trained under different methods,…
content: Venerable Sir, if it is indeed difficult for me, following different views, accepting different things, pursuing different goals, following different aims, trained under different methods, to attain purity and liberation, then at least, Venerable Sir, I will place my confidence in the Blessed One, and I will guard that faith well.

title: Whatever fears arise, bhikkhus, all those fears arise for the foolish, not for the wise. Whatever disappointments arise, all those disappointments arise for the foolish,…
content: Whatever fears arise, bhikkhus, all those fears arise for the foolish, not for the wise. Whatever disappointments arise, all those disappointments arise for the foolish, not for the wise. Whatever calamities arise, all those calamities arise for the foolish, not for the wise. Just as, bhikkhus, a spark from a grass hut can burn down a gabled house plastered inside and out, protected from the wind, with bolted doors and shutters — so too, bhikkhus, whatever fears arise, all those fears arise for the foolish, not for the wise; whatever disappointments arise, all those disappointments arise for the foolish, not for the wise; whatever calamities arise, all those calamities arise for the foolish, not for the wise. Thus, bhikkhus, the foolish is full of fear, the wise is without fear. The foolish is full of disappointment, the wise is without disappointment. The foolish is full of calamity, the wise is without calamity. Bhikkhus, there is no fear for the wise, no disappointment for the wise, no calamity for the wise. Therefore, bhikkhus, you should train yourselves: 'We will become wise and reflective.' Thus, bhikkhus, you should train yourselves.

title: They abandoned evil, unwholesome states; they were 'brāhmaṇā' (brahmins). And the name 'brāhmaṇa' was the first name that arose. These people built leaf huts in…
content: They abandoned evil, unwholesome states; they were 'brāhmaṇā' (brahmins). And the name 'brāhmaṇa' was the first name that arose. These people built leaf huts in the forests and meditated in those leaf huts. For them, the red-hot coals were extinguished, the smoke disappeared, the mortar and pestle fell askew. They ate in the evening for the evening meal, in the morning for the morning meal. They went into villages, towns, and capital cities for alms. Having obtained food, they returned to their leaf huts in the forests to practice meditation.

title: - Venerable Bharadvāja, what is the cause, what is the condition why these young bhikkhus, in their prime, with black hair, endowed with the blessing…
content: - Venerable Bharadvāja, what is the cause, what is the condition why these young bhikkhus, in their prime, with black hair, endowed with the blessing of youth, in the spring of life, do not indulge in sensual desires, but live the holy life completely pure for life, and live the full time perfectly?" - "Great King, the Blessed One, the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One, has said: 'Come, bhikkhus, toward those who are only mothers, establish the mind of a mother. Toward those who are only sisters, establish the mind of a sister. Toward those who are only daughters, establish the mind of a daughter.' Great King, this is the cause, this is the condition why these young bhikkhus... live the holy life completely pure for life, and live the full time perfectly.

title: ( Blessed One ): Beautiful parks, Beautiful forests, Beautiful lotus ponds, Are loved by people. They are only worth Little, insignificant. In village or in…
content:
( Blessed One ):
Beautiful parks,
Beautiful forests,
Beautiful lotus ponds,
Are loved by people.
They are only worth
Little, insignificant.
In village or in forest,
On low ground or high,
Wherever an Arahant dwells,
That place is truly beautiful.
